cases.assertion: Pinning an owned post, replacing it with another, and clearing it yield at most one pinned row. Profile page one deduplicates the pin against the ordinary timeline.
A non-owner cannot pin a post. A removed or inaccessible pinned post produces a null result for the requesting viewer and does not increment its views.
Pin endpoints return 503 with no request DDL on a missing feature schema. Ordinary profile posts still load.
